features.name: Chat with Copilot
features.description: An AI-powered chat assistant integrated into Business Central that allows users to find records through natural language queries, get answers to business process questions by searching official documentation, and receive field-level help. Launched with major update 24.0 and rolling out gradually across regions.
caveats: Only available for Business Central online, not on-premises or private cloud
Not available to Canadian customers due to compliance reasons
Cannot be extended or modified with custom capabilities
Not aware of current page context during early rollout
Documentation search limited to Business Central docs, not general web search
Does not generate AL code or display code in chat pane
Cannot answer questions about custom fields or company-specific processes
Can only find data based on available filters and fields

features.name: Record finding capability
features.description: Copilot can quickly find relevant records from the database by constructing filters on appropriate pages based on natural language queries, presenting results as interactive tiles.
caveats: Works by looking up relevant page and constructing filters
Can handle loose formulations but benefits from explicit specification of record type

features.name: Conversational query refinement
features.description: Users can ask follow-up questions in the chat to narrow down or modify results, with Copilot understanding the conversation history and context from previous queries.
caveats: During early rollout, not aware of current page context unless explicitly mentioned

features.name: Documentation search
features.description: Copilot can search official Business Central documentation to answer product-related questions about processes and terminology, providing links to relevant documentation pages.
caveats: Limited to Business Central documentation only, not general web search
Will decline to answer if information is not in documentation

features.name: Custom object support
features.description: Chat can find records in custom objects, custom tables, and custom list pages without requiring additional effort from partners.
caveats: Chat itself is not extensible - cannot modify or add new capabilities
Custom fields and company-specific knowledge sources are not supported

features.name: Shared results to Teams
features.description: Records found by Copilot can be shared to Teams for collaboration with coworkers.

features.name: No Additional Cost for Chat and Copilot
features.description: Chat and Copilot in Business Central are included with Business Central licenses at no additional cost and no minimum number of seats is required.

features.name: Chat Extensibility Not Available
features.description: Chat cannot be extended, modified, overridden, or have new capabilities added to it during preview. The product aspires to unlock extensibility in the future.
caveats: Extensibility not possible in current version

features.name: Responsible AI Standards in Chat
features.description: Chat is designed with Microsoft's responsible AI standards including fairness, reliability, safety, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability. Features grounding checks to avoid fabrications and provides citations to sources.

features.name: Data Protection and Permissions in Chat
features.description: Chat respects user permission sets and will not provide access to data the user does not have permission to access. User data is not used to train foundation AI models.

features.name: Chat Demo Environment Setup via CDX
features.description: Partners can use CDX (Customer Digital Experiences) to quickly spin up a new tenant with admin and test user credentials for demoing Chat with Copilot. US environments provide immediate access to chat.

features.name: Copilot Capabilities Page for Admins
features.description: A single page in the admin center that provides transparency on which generative AI features are available in a particular environment, including whether Chat is active.

features.name: Azure OpenAI Regional Consent
features.description: Some environments may require admin consent to allow Business Central to contact Azure OpenAI Service in a different geographic region, as data may need to be sent outside the user's geographic boundary.
caveats: Data may be sent to Azure OpenAI outside geographic boundary

features.name: Chat Field-Level Help Feature
features.description: Users can click on a field in Business Central to immediately get context-sensitive help from Copilot Chat, explaining what the field represents and how it works, without leaving the application.

features.name: Chat Feedback Mechanism
features.description: Users can provide feedback on Chat responses through thumbs up or thumbs down buttons in the chat pane. This feedback helps the product team identify areas for improvement without using data for training foundation models.
